body_markdown:
*Event to include comprehensive update and Lunar Systems tour*


DENVER–(BUSINESS WIRE)–


**Voyager Technologies (NYSE: VOYG)** will host its annual Investor Day December 3, 2026, in Pittsburgh.


“We are building Investor Day around giving investors more than a presentation — a real look at the technology and the team delivering it,” said Dylan Taylor, Chairman and CEO, Voyager. “From our core space and defense portfolio to the lunar systems work happening in Pittsburgh, we will show the market the full scope of what we’re building.”


During the event, Voyager’s executive leadership will provide a comprehensive update on the company’s business, strategic priorities and long-term growth opportunities, offering deeper insight into its key markets, capabilities and strategy.


In-person attendance is by invitation only and space is limited. Investors and analysts interested in attending may contact Voyager’s Investor Relations team atinvestors@voyagertechnologies.com .


A live webcast of the event will be available through the Investor Relations section of Voyager’s website at investors.voyagertechnologies.com. A replay of the webcast, along with presentation materials, will be made available following the event.


Voyager is also participating in the following upcoming conferences:


- **Global Space & Defense Tech Summit, Nov. 18** – Management will present and participate in investor meetings.
- **UBS Global Technology and AI Conference, Nov. 30** – Management will participate in investor meetings.


**About Voyager Technologies**


Voyager Technologies is a defense technology and space solutions company that enables mission-ready systems that secure today and power what’s next for the U.S. and partner nations. From propulsion and energetics to advanced electronics, mission management and space exploration, Voyager delivers capabilities that protect national security, reinforce the industrial base and expand human presence beyond Earth. For more information visit: voyagertechnologies.com and follow on[LinkedIn](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fvoyagertechnologies-inc&esheet=54619302&newsitemid=20261013720469&lan=en-US&anchor=LinkedIn&index=1&md5=f4e322e773b08c6c3cf0f0153a60ae9f) and[X](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Fvoyagertech_&esheet=54619302&newsitemid=20261013720469&lan=en-US&anchor=X&index=2&md5=a60a92c5f402c1c358871e02fc54b211) .
